review.actor_runtime_and_verifier_assessment: Actor execution uses the independently frozen actor/evaluator venv (mindmemos-eval-venv, freeze SHA ed0e582b...), exact resolved identity deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813, K=1, max_turns=10, max_output_tokens=4096, temperature=0, thinking=disabled, provider_retry_limit=0, and the controlled suite with SpreadsheetBenchEnv/verifier. The transition runner validates summary.skill_pre_sha256 == learned skill SHA, summary.updater_receipt_sha256 == receipt SHA, summary.k == 1, and task list == [r17-b0-agj-p4]. It does not promote the task score; development_task_outcome_used_for_promotion is false.
review.checkpoint_failure_preservation_assessme: If the update checkpoint exists, the runner revalidates update_receipt SHA and skill SHA before reuse, so a completed updater may be safely reused for evaluation via content-addressed checkpoint. If update_dir or eval_root exists with any content but no completed checkpoint/summary, the runner raises and refuses automatic rerun. On evaluation failure it writes evaluation_failure.json with provider_relaunch_authorized=false and preserves the stale lock (lock is only unlinked on success). This is consistent with the failure-differential policy.
review.development_task_selection_assessment: r17-b0-agj-p4 is fixed in the contract and is the lexicographically first task ID in the development split manifest. The transition runner passes --task-id r17-b0-agj-p4 explicitly and validates the authorization scope allowed_task_ids equals exactly [r17-b0-agj-p4]. The actor runner's task_ids_from_args uses the explicit --task-id path. No code path reads e1_common_heldout_probe or selects the development task based on learned-skill outcome. The split manifest confirms r17-b0-agj-p4 is in development, not in any E1 heldout list.
review.failure_learning_policy_assessment: The contract and runner separate runtime/implementation failure from scientific-mechanism failure. Evaluation failure is recorded as TECHNICAL_FAILURE with provider_relaunch_authorized=false and stale lock preserved. The final summary explicitly sets scientific_effectiveness_evaluated=false and negative_control_inference_performed=false. A transition Pilot failure cannot be used against R17's mechanism and must be diagnosed/versioned; conversely a PASS cannot support the R17 mechanism. This matches the failure-differential registry taxonomy.
review.historical_update_selection_assessment: The contract binds exactly eight historical E0 pool paths with explicit SHA-256 values and task IDs in a fixed order. load_selected_pools enforces len==8, per-file SHA match, per-pool task_id match, and exact order equality against the contract rows. The selection rule is lexicographically first eight pool_k8.json paths frozen before reading mixed/rescue/outcome fields. The update is WIN-only (ProjectionName.WINNER_ONLY) and uses BlindedEvidenceUnit with selected_evidence_trajectory score semantics, arm_metadata_visible=false, and causal_purity_mode=arm_blinded_selected_evidence. No outcome-driven reselection path exists.
nonblocking_notes: The transition runner computes mrw_units via evidence_units but discards them; this is harmless and does not execute MRW.

The actor runner's validate_authority accepts AUTHORIZED_E0/E1/PUBLIC_EXTERNALITY statuses generally, but the transition authorization is validated separately by validate_contract_auth to require AUTHORIZED_E1 with e1_b_transition_runtime_pilot=true and e1_b_negative_control=false.

The updater adapter's _respond has a poll-recovery path (max_polls=3) for ArkResponseStateError; this is not a provider retry of a new generation and does not consume additional budget claims, but reviewers may want to confirm it is acceptable under the retry=0 policy.
review.noninitial_skill_receipt_handoff_assessm: The actor receives --skill-source pointing to skill_post parent and --updater-receipt pointing to update_receipt.json. The actor runner revalidates: skill path exists, skill SHA matches receipt skill_post_sha256, receipt status COMPLETED, receipt skill_post_path resolves to the supplied skill path, receipt contract_sha256 equals evaluation authorization contract SHA, and receipt authorization_sha256 equals evaluation authorization SHA. Omission of a pre-known learned-skill SHA from authorization scope is scientifically acceptable because the learned SHA is only known after the provider update and is instead content-addressed by the bound update receipt, which itself binds contract and authorization SHAs.
review.scientific_boundary_assessment: Confirmed 0 E1 common heldout access (task scope is exactly r17-b0-agj-p4 from development; heldout_evaluation_calls=0; e1_common_heldout_accessed=false), 0 WIN-A/WIN-B equivalence inference (only one WIN update), 0 MRW execution (mrw_units computed but never passed to updater; mrw_executed=false), 0 learned-skill effect promotion (development_task_outcome_used_for_promotion=false; scientific_effectiveness_evaluated=false), and 0 paper authority (paper_promotion=false, submission=false). The single development outcome only proves the verifier completes with a receipt-bound noninitial skill.
review.shared_provider_budget_assessment: One ProviderBudgetLedger is shared. total_limit=20, per_unit_limit=10, claim_before_provider_io=true, claims_never_released=true. The updater unit id is e1-b-transition/update_win and nominally consumes 10 calls (enforced by require result.provider_calls == 10). The actor rollout unit id is {task_id}/rollout_0 and is capped at 10 by per_unit_limit. The ledger binds contract and authorization SHAs and fails closed on metadata drift. Neither role can reset/reinitialize the ledger: allow_create is only true when the file does not exist, and _initialize_or_validate refuses to initialize missing metadata on resume. Claims are committed before provider I/O and never released.
review.single_sentence_verdict: The transition Pilot is causally pure, budget fail-closed, receipt-bound, and scientifically inert, so it may proceed under a separately authorized frozen transition-runtime Pilot while E1-B negative control and MRW remain on HOLD.
review.updater_causal_purity_assessment: The updater path uses ExactMatchedEvidenceBlockRenderer (bound SHA 6a79d4e6...), BlindedEvidenceUnit, selected evidence score, pinned SkillEvolver at MindMemOS commit 90491828726e1540442b17cd445d0308d0b8093c, dedicated updater runtime (mindmemos-updater-venv), temperature=0.0, provider_retry_limit=0, thinking=disabled, max_parse_attempts=1. The transition runner requires sys.executable == updater venv python. No MRW arm is generated (only win_units; mrw_units are computed by evidence_units but discarded by the transition runner, which passes only win_units to run_projection_update). No A/B comparison occurs.
